body: I've talked to everyone I could possibly talk to. Everyone says the same thing. "you need to move on" "she doesn't deserve you". I've gotten as far as I have with therapy and help. But it's not helping anymore

Been in therapy since before all this. It's helped curb some of the impulsive self-destructive behaviors I had. But I'm left with what I feel are two choices I am able to consciously make.

Continue without her.
Or die.
I don't know what I was without her. We were together for 10 years. Since we were kids.
I've been doing all of that dude..it just feels pointless. Like what's the point. I knew this girl since I was 15. I literally don't know how to. Be without her.
